EU.note: Assumed: ECB reference rate 2.40% on 1 July 2026 (applies to H2 2026) + 8 percentage points under Directive 2011/7/EU. Some countries apply a higher margin or another reference rate - check the rate for the debtor's country.

UK.note: Bank of England base rate + 8 percentage points (Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998). The base rate on 31 Dec applies to invoices due in January-June, the rate on 30 June to invoices due in July-December. Base rate was 3.75% on both dates in 2026.
